popCulture.title: Riddle of the Sphinx
popCulture.description: The Theban monster's riddle — four legs, two legs, three — remains the West's stock emblem of a question that kills if unanswered.

popCulture.title: Oedipus and the Sphinx
popCulture.creator: Jean-Auguste-Dominique Ingres
popCulture.description: Ingres' Louvre canvas fixed the modern image of the confrontation — the hero facing the winged woman-lion on the Theban road.
